context: Evaluates correct use of the Wormhole compound component pattern to compose custom 3D scenes. Tests that individual subcomponents (Provider, Frame, Tunnel, Rings, Stars, Lighting, Fog) are correctly composed, and that the compound component API is used rather than reimplementing internals.

checklist.name: Wormhole.Provider Usage
checklist.description: Wormhole.Provider (or WormholeProvider) is used as the root wrapper, with callback props passed through correctly

checklist.name: Wormhole.Frame Usage
checklist.description: Wormhole.Frame is used as the layout wrapper containing the visual scene subcomponents

checklist.name: Tunnel and Rings Composition
checklist.description: Wormhole.Tunnel and Wormhole.Rings are composed inside the frame, rendering the procedural tunnel and glow effects

checklist.name: Selective Subcomponent Omission
checklist.description: Subcomponents like Wormhole.Stars can be selectively omitted from composition without causing errors in remaining components

checklist.name: Lighting and Fog
checklist.description: Wormhole.Lighting and Wormhole.Fog are included in the scene composition for correct visual appearance
